title: Add department-scoped employee directory API
decisions: All authenticated employees may read only the requested department; administrator authorization remains for department management routes.
The endpoint is GET /api/departments/{departmentCode}/employees with search, page, limit, sort_by, and sort_order query parameters.

The existing schema had no members.phone column. Migration 026 adds a non-null VARCHAR(50) column with an empty default; existing phone values therefore remain empty until a separate write flow is provided.
The response uses a dedicated read-only employee directory entry so password, permission, timestamps, and unrelated member fields cannot leak.
breaking_change: No existing route is removed. The new phone column is additive; existing employee records receive an empty phone value.
